newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Defiance says sale shows bid is short.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Defiance says sale shows bid is short.

text.p: Baking and milling group Defiance Mills Ltd said on Friday the sale of its New Zealand operations to Goodman Fielder Ltd shows a takeover offer by Bunge Corp for Defiance is "totally inadequate".
The Latin American-based food and industrial giant Bunge Corp on Tuesday offered A$1.70 per share for Defiance. The aggregate value of the bid is A$97 million.
Defiance said the planned A$48 million sale of its New Zealand unit to Goodman Fielder was part of an aggressive renewal programme planned to increase shareholder value.
Defiance chairman Tom O'Brien said the agreement followed an approach by Goodman Fielder several months ago.
The sale was testament to previously stated assertions that Bunge's offer was "totally inadequate and understates the value of the company," O'Brien said in a statement.
O'Brien earlier this week did not rule out a counter-offer from Defiance for Bunge's Australian milling operations.
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission said on Wednesday it would not intervene in Bunge's bid for Defiance.
